heading: •An Enemy Of The Republic (V)
base_lore: Many Jawas were killed by stormtroopers searching for R2-D2. They used banthas and gaffi sticks to feign a Tusken Raider attack, but Obi-Wan saw through the ruse.

notes: Group: Imperial Senate (sheet page 'Virtual Set 16: Imperial Senate', DARK SIDE). COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1099 crop) on the red Dark Effect frame. Top to bottom: (1) TITLE BAR: the green Effect disc (printed Dead Jawa: red Lost Interrupt disc); title '•An Enemy Of The Republic' (unique; the printed Dead Jawa is unrestricted); destiny 6 (printed 5 → destiny '6', base_destiny '5'). (2) LORE BOX PRINTED EMPTY — a plain black box with no text → lore '' (printed Dead Jawa lore kept in base_lore; the PC's VB5 reissue also shows the empty lore box). Right of the lore box: only the black EPISODE I icon (Premiere prints no expansion ring) → ring_icons ['episode1'] (slip addition). (3) ART WINDOW blank white; no copyright on the slip (Premiere 1995 line stays from the printed card). (4) Banner EFFECT, no grabber box (grabber false); game text 6 lines in the black text box; no icon column; VS16 set sphere at the bottom right. Banner/text box at the printed heights (not a tall slip). (5) Bottom strip: caption 'Dead Jawa (V)' (no dot, as the printed card), number 40; heading '•An Enemy Of The Republic (V)'. CHANGES vs Decipher Dead Jawa (Premiere Lost Interrupt, Premiere-D-deadjawa.gif 350 px): title, uniqueness, disc, destiny 5 → 6, lore removed, Episode I icon added, banner LOST INTERRUPT → EFFECT, text replaced (printed: 'If two or more Stormtroopers are present where the opponent has Jawas, target as many Jawas there as desired. Draw destiny. If destiny > the number of Jawas you targeted, they are immediately lost.'). ▲ in the last line where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. base_lore matches the wiki and the scan. Expansion per the wiki base page (|set=Premiere Limited). Modern: VB5-D-anenemyoftherepublic-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 5 reissue; its text is an older/shorter revision). Slip text matches the stub.
